Health information

WeightWatchers Points Calculator

We do not calculate or estimate official WeightWatchers Points. Points budgets and food values are personalized and can depend on the current program and your account.

Check your current Points in WeightWatchers

Use the official WeightWatchers app or website to view your personalized budget and track foods. Program details can change, so an unofficial formula or a value copied from an older plan may not match your current account.

Read how the WeightWatchers program works. NS Calculators is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WeightWatchers.

Need a different nutrition estimate?

A calorie estimate is not a Points conversion and should not be treated as one. You can use our calorie calculator for an estimate based on the inputs and assumptions shown there.

This page is general information, not nutrition or medical advice. Follow guidance from your healthcare professional for individual dietary needs.
